name: rarecloud
description: Skills that take an app from working locally to online on any provider, plus RareCloud's own skill and MCP server. The MCP tools need a RareCloud account and API token; the skills work without them.

settings.name: RareCloud API token
settings.description: A RareCloud API token, created at https://console.rarecloud.io/account/api. Only the MCP tools need it.
